raw_text: Niger coup update from sources in Niamey. Presidential guard Colonel Tchiani is reportedly leading the takeover. Soldiers have blocked all entrances to the presidential palace. Pro-coup demonstrators gathering in central Niamey waving Russian flags and chanting anti-France slogans. Communication lines to the palace have been cut. French embassy advising nationals to stay indoors.
